intro.rationale: Starts 22ms before the strong 20.155s downbeat and follows five recurring beat accents. The envelope reaches digital zero at 4.700s, leaving 300ms clear before narration.

outro.rationale: Uses the track's authored final cadence; its natural decay is below -60 dBFS by 73.677s. The explicit envelope reaches zero at 5.700s and leaves the final 300ms silent.

leveling.rationale: Music is set near -22 LUFS, about 1 LU below representative narration around -21 LUFS, with substantially lower peaks. The intro is then silent for 300ms before the lesson.

concatStrategy.type: FFmpeg concat demuxer with stream copy
concatStrategy.rationale: All 31 masters share one H.264/AAC signature. Music is encoded only into the bookend AAC streams; the approved lesson H.264 and AAC packets are remuxed without re-encoding. Six masters retain two negative AAC priming packets, so their intro tracks end earlier and leave those packets their original timestamp lead-in.

verification.bodyFrameMethod: SHA-256 of decoded RGB24 frames at matching middle-body timestamps
verification.lessonAudioMethod: SHA-256 of the complete decoded lesson body as f32le 48kHz stereo PCM at matching timestamps
verification.lessonAudioAlsoProves: No music is present during the lesson body.
verification.concatDiagnostics: FFmpeg warning output must be empty, including at AAC priming boundaries.

stills.note: Intro B has no lesson title at 2.4s, so the contact sheet uses the additional settled-title still at 4.2s.
